# PS1002 — per-element-closure

<!-- Generated by cmd/gendocs; do not edit. Run make docs. -->

**a per-element visitor fed a closure (an indirect call per element)**

- Category: `access`
- Fix level: **L2**
- Auto-fix: no (advisory)
- Domain check: requires vocabulary `perElementVisitors` in perfscan.json

A visitor helper (readGen, fillGen, …) that takes a closure calls
it once per element: an indirect call the compiler cannot inline, per
element. Replace the closure with a typed bulk loop over the backing slice,
or specialize the visitor for the hot dtype.

Domain check: which helpers count as per-element visitors is project
vocabulary (perElementVisitors in perfscan.json).

## Example

Before:

```go
readGen(t, func(i int, v float64) {
	sum += v
})
```

After:

```go
if xs, ok := t.flatF64(); ok {
	for _, v := range xs {
		sum += v
	}
} else {
	readGen(t, func(i int, v float64) { sum += v })
}
```

## Suppressing

```go
//perfscan:ignore PS1002 <reason>
```
